Satya Nadella has a new 'headache', Microsoft's 'breakup' with Disney, as Mouse House dumps ...

Disney is dropping GitHub Copilot and several AI coding tools in the US. The company will adopt OpenAI's Codex as its coding assistant. Disney is also retaining access to Anthropic's Claude Enterprise and Cursor. Two Amazon tools, Kiro and Q, will also be dropped. Claude will no longer be accessible
